ESCORTS.NS.d: Escorts Limited manufactures and sells agri machinery, construction equipment, and railway equipment in India and internationally. The company offers agricultural tractors under the Farmtrac, Powertrac, and Steeltrac brands; crop solutions; engines; spare parts; lubricants; and sprayers, harvesters, implements, planters, and gensets.

FIVESTAR.NS.d: Five-Star Business Finance Limited is an Indian non-banking financial company. It lends small business and mortgage loans to micro-entrepreneurs and self-employed people for business needs, home renovation, weddings, healthcare and education. Incorporated in 1984, it is headquartered in Chennai.

GEOJITFSL.NS.d: Geojit Financial Services Limited, an investment services company, provides broking and financial services in India, Oman, Kuwait, the United Arab Emirates, and Saudi Arabia. The company operates through Financial Services and Software Services segments. The Financial Services segment offers brokerage, depository, financial products distribution, portfolio management, and other related services. The Software services segment develops and maintains software.

HAVISHA.NS.d: Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited does not have significant operations. The company intends to acquire or merge with other company, which is in hospitality/tourism business. Previously, it was engaged in bottling liquid petroleum gas. The company was formerly known as Shri Matre Power & Infrastructure Limited and changed its name to Sri Havisha Hospitality and Infrastructure Limited in November 2016.

IBLFL.NS.d: IBL Finance Ltd. is an India-based fintech Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in providing diverse financial solutions. The company's primary operations involve offering personal loans and financing solutions to a broad client base. Its product portfolio includes instant personal loans, micro, small, and medium enterprise (MSME) loans, business loans, gold loans, microfinance, vehicle finance, education loans, agricultural loans, and loans against property.

INDOSTAR.NS.d: IndoStar Capital Finance Limited, a non-banking financial company, provides various financing services to corporates, and small and medium enterprises in India. It offers secured corporate lending products, including senior secured debt, structured financing, promoter funding, mezzanine funding, structured and acquisition financing, and real estate developer financing products; as well as loans for construction of commercial and residential properties.

INDPRUD.NS.d: Industrial & Prudential Investment Company Limited is an Indian investment company. They primarily manage a portfolio of investments in different sectors. The company is based in Kolkata, India.

JTEKTINDIA.NS.d: JTEKT India Limited manufactures and sells steering systems and other auto components for the passenger car and utility vehicle manufacturers in the automobile sector in India and internationally. The company offers steering gears, columns and RPS assemblies, axle assemblies, and other auto ancillaries. It also exports its products to the United States, Europe, and Japan. The company was formerly known as Sona Koyo Steering Systems Limited and changed its name to JTEKT India Limited in April 2018.

KIRLPNU.NS.d: Kirloskar Pneumatic Company Limited (KPCL), established in Pune in 1958, designs, makes and sells industrial equipment in India and overseas. Its products include reciprocating, screw and centrifugal air and gas compressors, pneumatic tools and process refrigeration systems.

KSHITIJPOL-SM.NS.d: Kshitij Polyline Limited manufactures and supplies stationery products, office supplies, and printing materials. The company offers a range of products to meet the needs of schools, offices, and businesses. The company is based in India.

LEMONTREE.NS.d: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited owns and operates a chain of business and leisure hotels. As of January 14, 2021, it operated 83 hotels with approximately 8,200 rooms across 50 destinations in India and internationally under various brands, including Aurika Hotels & Resorts, Lemon Tree Premier, Lemon Tree Hotels, Red Fox Hotels, Keys Prima, Keys Select and Keys Lite. The company also provides project design and management, as well as housing rental services.

LENSKART.NS.d: Lenskart Solutions Limited is a technology-driven eyewear company that designs, manufactures, brands and retails eyewear in India, Japan, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. Its products include prescription glasses, sunglasses, screen glasses, contact lenses and accessories for men, women and children, and it also makes and edges lenses.

MURUDCERA.NS.d: Murudeshwar Ceramics Ltd. manufactures and sells ceramic and Vitrified floor and wall tiles in India, the Americas, South America, Europe, and internationally. It offers wall tiles, such as bathroom, kitchen, and outdoor tiles; and floor tiles, such as glazed and polished glazed vitrified, double charge, soluble salt, full body, and exteriors tiles, as well as wooden strips under the Naveen Ceramic Tiles and Naveen Diamontile brand names.

NACLIND.NS.d: NACL Industries Limited manufactures and sells agrochemicals in India. The company offers a range of technicals, including myclobutanil, propiconazole, profenofos, tricyclazole, and pretilachlors; and formulations, such as insecticides, fungicides, herbicides, and plant growth regulators and nematicides, as well as pesticides and acaricides. It also provides toll manufacturing services for various multinational companies. The company also exports its products to approximately 30 countries worldwide.

NAGREEKCAP.NS.d: Nagreeka Capital & Infrastructure Ltd. is a publicly owned investment manager. The firm invests in equity markets, private equity, mutual funds, real estate, and renewable energy. The firm was founded Nagreeka Securities Ltd. and changed its name to Nagreeka Software Technologies Limited in September 2001. Nagreeka Software Technologies Limited further changed its name to Nagreeka Capital & Infrastructure Ltd. in July 2006. Nagreeka Capital & Infrastructure Ltd.

NILKAMAL.NS.d: Nilkamal Limited, together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells plastic products primarily in India. It operates in two segments, Plastics; and Lifestyle Furniture, Furnishings and Accessories.

OLIL.NS.d: Oneclick Logistics India Ltd. is an Indian freight forwarding and logistics company that provides end-to-end integrated logistics solutions. The company's primary services include air and ocean freight, warehousing, custom house brokerage, project cargo, and clearing and forwarding services. They also offer road freight, bulk cargo handling, and allied logistics and transportation services, encompassing supply chain management.

ONEGLOBAL.NS.d: One Global Service Provider Limited is a company listed on the National Stock Exchange of India under the ticker ONEGLOBAL and traded in INR. Its country is India.

ORICONENT.NS.d: Oricon Enterprises Limited engages in real estate, marine logistics, packaging, and petrochemicals businesses in India and internationally. It is involved in marine logistics, including lighterage, stevedoring, and logistics for dry cargos, such as coal, petcoke, polypropylene polymer, cent, clinter, steel plates, salt, sugar, etc.; the manufacturing and marketing packaging products, such as metal and plastic closures; and manufacture and sale of petrochemicals, including mixed pentane and heptane for industrial…

PAR.NS.d: Par Drugs and Chemicals Limited develops, makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients and specialty chemicals in India. Its products include magnesium salts, aluminum hydroxide gel, sodium aluminum silicate, precipitated and colloidal silica and sucralfate, and it exports internationally. Founded in 1982, it is headquartered in Vadodara.

PRUDENT.NS.d: Prudent Corporate Advisory Services Limited, established in 2000, is an Indian financial advisory firm serving individual investors, companies and high and ultra-high net worth clients. It distributes mutual funds, insurance, portfolio management schemes, unlisted securities, bonds, alternative investment funds and pension schemes, and also offers stock brokerage, financial planning and real estate consultancy.

QUICKHEAL.NS.d: Quick Heal Technologies Limited provides security software products and solutions to consumer, small businesses, government establishments, and corporate houses in India and internationally. The company offers cloud-based products under the Quick Heal and Seqrite brands. It also offers technical service and after-sales support services. The company sells its products through a network of service providers, system-integrators, resellers, and distributors.

SAKHTISUG.NS.d: Sakthi Sugars Limited manufactures and sells sugar in India, Korea, Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam. It operates through Sugar, Industrial Alcohol, Soya Products, and Power segments. The company offers white and refined sugar; industrial alcohol, including rectified spirit, extra neutral alcohol/neutral spirit, and ethanol manufactured from molasses; sugar by-products, such as molasses, bagasse, and press mud; bio earth products for use as an organic fertilizer and soil improver; and soya products.

SESHAPAPER.NS.d: Seshasayee Paper and Boards Limited operates an integrated pulp, paper, and paper board mill in Tamilnadu, India. The company offers printing and writing papers. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1960 and is based in Erode, India.

SPECTRUM.NS.d: Spectrum Electrical Industries Limited began in 2008 in Mumbai and designs, manufactures and sells components used by Indian electrical, automotive and irrigation businesses. Its electrical range includes distribution boards, modular panels, MCB bases, lamp holders, EV chargers, control panels, junction boxes and safety devices, alongside general vehicle and irrigation parts.

TAKE.NS.d: TAKE Solutions Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides domain-intensive services and solutions in life sciences and supply chain management in the United States, Asia Pacific, and Europe. It offers IP-driven and technology backed solutions, consulting, technology, and functional services across clinical, regulatory, and safety for life sciences industry.

TEGA.NS.d: Tega Industries Limited designs, makes and installs process equipment and accessories for mineral processing, mining and material handling. Its products include grinding mill liners, conveyor components, ceramic, composite and rubber wear liners, air blasters, engineered chutes, screens and trommels.

TIRUPATIFL.NS.d: Tirupati Forge Limited manufactures and sells carbon steel forged flanges, and forged and other automotive components in India. The company provides slip-on, weld-neck, blind, lap-joint, threaded, and socket weld flanges; and din, conical, and plate flanges. It also offers auto parts, bearings, gears, crank shafts, hammer unions, forged pipe fittings, and seamless rolled rings. The company offers its products under the Tirupati brand name.

UNIMECH.NS.d: Unimech Aerospace and Manufacturing Limited specializes in precision engineering for customers in India and overseas, organized as an aero-tooling and MRO tooling segment plus a precision components and assemblies segment. It builds jigs, fixtures, gauges and handling equipment for aircraft engines and airframes, and makes precision parts for aerospace, defense, energy and semiconductor industries.

VAISHALI.NS.d: Vaishali Pharma Limited engages in the pharmaceutical business in India and internationally. It offers active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs), including antibiotics, anti-ulcer, anti-inflammatory/analgesic/anti-pyretic, anti-malarial, cardiac, anti-diabetic, anti-cold/anti-allergic, anti-diarrheal/anti-protozoal/anti-parasitic, anti-viral, anti-epileptic, anti-asthmatic, anti-fungal, anti-platelet agent, skeletal muscle relaxant, and anti-helmintic drugs, as well as excipients, topical steroids, corticosteroids,…

VENKEYS.NS.d: Venky's (India) Limited engages in the production and sale of poultry products in India. It operates through three segments: Poultry and Poultry Products, Animal Health Products, and Oilseed. The Poultry and Poultry Products segment produces and sells day old broiler and layer chicks, specific pathogen free eggs, processed chicken products, poultry feeds, and other miscellaneous poultry products. The Animal Health Products segment produces and sells medicines and other health products for birds.

VHL.NS.d: Vardhman Holdings Limited operates as a non-banking financial company in India. It is primarily engages in lending and investing activities. The company was formerly known as Vardhman Spinning and General Mills Limited and changed its name to Vardhman Holdings Limited in March 2006. Vardhman Holdings Limited was incorporated in 1962 and is based in Ludhiana, India.

YCCL.NS.d: Yasons Chemex Care Ltd. is an Indian company engaged in the manufacturing and trading of dyes, intermediates, and various chemicals, alongside a Fast-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) product line. The company manufactures and trades a broad range of dyestuffs, including reactive, direct, basic, vat, food colorants, natural, synthetic, and synthetic organic dyes.
